title: Jets' Geno Smith silencing critics of his QB1 status with impressive drive in first preseason start

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Jets' Geno Smith silencing critics of his QB1 status with impressive drive in first preseason start
sources.description: After a couple of weeks of iffy practice play and missing a preseason start due to injury, Geno Smith showed why he's the Jets' QB1 on Friday night against the Steelers.
